text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Neo Geo AES was released in 1990 as the home version of SNK's arcade Neo Geo MVS hardware. Unlike traditional consoles, the AES used large cartridges that contained arcade-quality games with the same software found in SNK arcade machines. The system became known for its fighting games, arcade conversions, and long-lasting support. Its library included major franchises such as Fatal Fury, The King of Fighters, Samurai Shodown, Metal Slug, Art of Fighting, and Garou: Mark of the Wolves. The hardware remained technically impressive throughout the 1990s but was expensive due to its arcade-focused design. The Neo Geo AES continued production for many years and remains one of the most recognizable arcade-style home consoles.
